title: sieve: evaluate() implementation and integration tests
description:
Implement the evaluate() function body in crates/sieve/src/lib.rs using the sieve-rs event loop. sieve-rs uses a callback/event model: Runtime::filter(message) returns an Instance; call instance.run(Input::default()) in a loop, matching on Output events: Output::Action(Action::FileInto{mailbox,..}) -> SieveAction::FileInto(mailbox), Output::Action(Action::Keep{..}) -> SieveAction::Keep, Output::Action(Action::Discard) -> SieveAction::Discard, Output::Action(Action::Reject{reason,..}) -> SieveAction::Reject(reason), Output::Err(_) -> log warning and continue, Output::None -> break. Check exact sieve-rs 0.7 API by reading ~/.cargo/registry/src/**/sieve-rs-*/src/lib.rs before writing any code.

Integration tests (tests/sieve_tests.rs): use Dovecot Pigeonhole test scripts as oracle — copy 3-4 representative .svtest cases (fileinto, header match, size test, variables) and translate to Rust test assertions. Also test: script with no action produces Keep, fileinto produces correct mailbox path, discard produces Discard, implicit keep when if-condition false.
